_comment: Human-verified fixes linked to the knowledge-base runbooks (kb = file name in data/knowledge). They are retrieved by meaning and reused with no LLM call (routing level L3). Fictional company: Acme Demo Industries.

solutions.title: GlobalProtect rejects sign-in after the Authenticator approval
solutions.problem: GlobalProtect VPN fails with authentication failed right after I approve the Microsoft Authenticator request. It worked last week.
solutions.symptoms: Authentication failed after MFA; agent returns to Not connected
solutions.root_cause: Expired single sign-on session cached by the GlobalProtect agent.
steps: Disconnect GlobalProtect and choose Sign Out from the tray icon
Sign in once at https://myaccount.acme-demo.in to refresh single sign-on
Make sure the laptop clock is set automatically
Reconnect GlobalProtect and approve the Authenticator number within 60 seconds

solutions.title: GlobalProtect keeps dropping and reconnecting from home
solutions.problem: The VPN connects but drops every few minutes, Teams calls freeze and my file share disconnects while working from home.
solutions.root_cause: Weak home Wi-Fi combined with a stale DNS cache on the laptop.
steps: Move closer to the router or use a network cable
Close any other VPN or proxy app
Restart the GlobalProtect service (the agent can do this with your approval)
Flush the DNS cache (the agent can do this with your approval)
Reconnect and keep the agent open for ten minutes

solutions.title: VPN connected but intranet and mapped drives unreachable
solutions.problem: GlobalProtect says connected but the intranet does not open and my mapped drives have a red cross. Public websites load fine.
solutions.symptoms: Internal names do not resolve over VPN
solutions.root_cause: Laptop kept the home router as DNS server after reconnecting.
steps: Disconnect and reconnect GlobalProtect
Flush the DNS cache (the agent can do this with your approval)
Open https://connect.acme-demo.in by its full name
Disconnect old mapped drives that point to fs-old or nas01

solutions.title: FortiClient plant VPN stuck at 40 percent
solutions.problem: FortiClient for the Chennai plant systems stops at 40 percent and says the VPN server may be unreachable.
solutions.symptoms: FortiClient -14 style unreachable error; GlobalProtect also running
solutions.root_cause: GlobalProtect was still connected; the two clients cannot run together.
steps: Disconnect GlobalProtect first
Use the ACME-PLANT profile with gateway plant-vpn.acme-demo.in port 10443
Sign in with your company account and approve the prompt
Try a phone hotspot if your home router blocks port 10443

solutions.title: ACME-CORP Wi-Fi connected without internet on one laptop
solutions.problem: My laptop joins the office Wi-Fi but every website times out and the icon shows no internet, secured. Others on my floor are fine.
solutions.root_cause: Stale certificate selection after the laptop had joined the guest network.
steps: Check you are on ACME-CORP, not ACME-GUEST
Turn Wi-Fi off and on again
Forget ACME-CORP and join it again
Flush the DNS cache (the agent can do this with your approval)

solutions.title: New laptop cannot join ACME-CORP and asks for a password
solutions.problem: My new laptop cannot connect to the ACME-CORP wireless network in the office and keeps asking for a username and password.
solutions.symptoms: Can't connect to this network; credential prompt on 802.1X SSID
solutions.root_cause: Wi-Fi certificate not yet delivered because the device had not synced with the Company Portal.
steps: Connect to ACME-GUEST or a wired port
Open the Company Portal and choose Sync, then wait five minutes
Restart and select ACME-CORP; cancel any username prompt
Fix anything the Company Portal lists as not compliant

solutions.title: Hot desk dock shows network cable unplugged
solutions.problem: At my hot desk the wired network is not working through the dock, Windows says network cable unplugged, Wi-Fi works.
solutions.root_cause: Dock lost its network link after a power interruption.
steps: Check both ends of the network cable
Unplug the dock power for 30 seconds and reconnect
Try another desk to see whether the fault stays with the desk
Note the wall port label for the ticket

solutions.title: Outlook closes on start after the monthly Office update
solutions.problem: Outlook crashes a few seconds after opening since this morning's update. Outlook on the web works.
solutions.symptoms: Microsoft Outlook has stopped working; safe mode works
solutions.root_cause: Outdated COM add-in incompatible with the new Office build.
steps: End any OUTLOOK.EXE process in Task Manager
Start Outlook in safe mode by holding Ctrl
Disable recently installed COM add-ins and restart Outlook
Clear the Outlook cache (the agent can do this with your approval)

solutions.title: Outlook and Teams keep asking to sign in after a password change
solutions.problem: Outlook keeps showing need password and the sign-in window comes back every few minutes. Teams also says sign in required.
solutions.symptoms: Repeated sign-in prompts across Office apps
solutions.root_cause: Office sign-in token still tied to the previous password.
steps: Lock and unlock the laptop with your current password
In Outlook, File > Office Account > Sign out, then close all Office apps
Open Outlook and sign in with your company address
Connect to the office network or VPN if the password changed elsewhere

solutions.title: Email bounces back because the attachment is too large
solutions.problem: My email to a client came back undeliverable with message too large. It had several drawings attached.
solutions.root_cause: Attachments above the 25 MB transport limit.
steps: Read the code in the bounce message
Upload the files to OneDrive and share with specific people
Send the email again with the sharing link instead of attachments

solutions.title: Team calendar stopped updating in Outlook
solutions.problem: The shared team calendar in Outlook is out of date, new meetings show on my phone but not on the laptop.
solutions.symptoms: Calendar not syncing on desktop Outlook
solutions.root_cause: Corrupted offline copy of the shared calendar.
steps: Right-click the calendar and choose Properties > Clear Offline Items
Press Send/Receive
Sign out of Teams and sign in again if Teams meetings are missing

solutions.title: Cannot send because the mailbox is full
solutions.problem: Outlook says my mailbox size limit is exceeded and I cannot send any email.
solutions.root_cause: Large attachments in Sent Items and Deleted Items.
steps: Open File > Tools > Mailbox Cleanup > View Mailbox Size
Save large attachments to OneDrive and delete those messages
Empty Deleted Items and Recoverable Items
Move older folders to the Online Archive

solutions.title: Colleagues cannot hear me in Teams meetings
solutions.problem: In Teams meetings nobody can hear me even though my headset is connected, and sometimes I hear them through the laptop speakers.
solutions.symptoms: Wrong audio device selected after docking
solutions.root_cause: Teams kept the laptop's built-in devices after the headset was plugged into the dock.
steps: Open More > Settings > Device settings and select the headset for speaker and microphone
Plug the headset directly into the laptop instead of the dock
Close other apps that use the microphone or camera, then rejoin

solutions.title: Forgotten or expired password reset through self-service
solutions.problem: I forgot my password after coming back from leave and Windows says the user name or password is incorrect.
solutions.root_cause: Password expired during leave (180-day policy).
steps: From any browser open https://myaccount.acme-demo.in and choose Forgot my password
Verify with the Authenticator app or the registered mobile
Set a new password of at least 14 characters
Connect to the office network or VPN and sign in to the laptop with the new password

solutions.title: Account keeps locking after a password change
solutions.problem: My account got locked again this morning, I changed my password yesterday and it locks within minutes.
solutions.symptoms: Repeated lockouts; phone email stops syncing
solutions.root_cause: Phone mail app still signing in with the old password.
steps: Unlock the account at https://myaccount.acme-demo.in (or approve the agent's unlock)
Update the password in Outlook and Teams on your phone
Sign out of shared or meeting-room PCs you used earlier
Wait 15 minutes and confirm the lockout does not return

solutions.title: Authenticator not set up on a new phone
solutions.problem: I got a new phone and the Authenticator app has no work account, sign-in asks me to approve on my old phone.
solutions.symptoms: MFA requests go to the previous phone
solutions.root_cause: Authenticator registration still points to the old device.
steps: Open https://myaccount.acme-demo.in > Security info while the old phone still works
Add sign-in method > Authenticator app and scan the QR code with the new phone
Set the new phone as default and delete the old one

solutions.title: Authenticator approvals not arriving on the phone
solutions.problem: Sign-in waits for approval but the Authenticator notification never shows on my phone, and the code is rejected.
solutions.root_cause: Battery optimisation stopped notifications; phone clock drifted.
steps: Open the Authenticator app to see pending requests
Allow notifications and turn off battery optimisation for Authenticator
Set the phone date and time to automatic
Use the text-message option on the sign-in screen meanwhile

solutions.title: Secure Print jobs stuck in the laptop queue
solutions.problem: My documents stay in the print queue with error printing and nothing appears when I tap my badge at the printer.
solutions.root_cause: Hung print spooler on the laptop after a large PDF job.
steps: Cancel the stuck job in the Acme Secure Print queue window
Restart the print spooler (the agent can do this with your approval)
Print a one-page test from Notepad
Tap your badge and release the job

solutions.title: Acme Secure Print missing or offline on a laptop
solutions.problem: The office printer does not appear on my new laptop, or it shows offline when I try to print.
solutions.root_cause: Secure Print package not installed; laptop outside the company network.
steps: Install Acme Secure Print from the Company Portal
Connect to the office network or VPN
Remove old printers you no longer use

solutions.title: Scans from the multifunction device never arrive by email
solutions.problem: The scanner says sent but the scanned document never reaches my inbox, only short scans arrive.
solutions.root_cause: Colour scans above the 20 MB limit.
steps: Tap your badge before scanning so Scan to Me uses your address
Choose Black & White at 200 dpi for long documents
Check Junk Email for scanner@acme-demo.in

solutions.title: Laptop dead after being left on a dock over the weekend
solutions.problem: My laptop will not turn on this morning, no lights at all, and the battery said plugged in not charging on Friday.
solutions.symptoms: No power; not charging through dock
solutions.root_cause: Battery fully drained; dock cannot start a drained laptop.
steps: Connect the original charger directly to the laptop for 30 minutes
Hold the power button for 20 seconds, then press it once
Try a colleague's charger of the same model

solutions.title: External monitors show no signal through the dock
solutions.problem: Both external monitors on my docking station show no signal after the laptop wakes up, the laptop screen works.
solutions.root_cause: Dock needed a power reset after sleep.
steps: Unplug the dock power for 30 seconds, then reconnect power and the laptop
Press Windows key + P and choose Extend
Use Detect in Display settings
Install pending dock firmware from the Company Portal

solutions.title: Wireless keyboard and mouse stop responding
solutions.problem: My wireless keyboard and mouse work for a few seconds and then stop responding.
solutions.root_cause: Low batteries and receiver plugged into the dock.
steps: Replace the batteries
Plug the USB receiver directly into the laptop
Restart the laptop

solutions.title: Installer asks for an administrator password
solutions.problem: I need Power BI Desktop for a report but the installer I downloaded asks for an administrator name and password.
solutions.root_cause: Standard users install software through the Company Portal only.
steps: Open the Company Portal and search for the application
Choose Install if it is listed
Otherwise choose Request an app and give the business reason

solutions.title: Excel shows unlicensed product after a team move
solutions.problem: Excel and Word show a red unlicensed product bar and open read-only since I moved to the new team.
solutions.root_cause: Office signed in with a personal account; licence token not refreshed.
steps: Check File > Account shows your name@acme-demo.in account
Sign out of any personal account and close all Office apps
Sign in again and choose Update License
Restart the laptop if the banner remains

solutions.title: Desktop application closes after the splash screen following an update
solutions.problem: Power BI Desktop closes right after the splash screen since the update last night.
solutions.root_cause: Damaged local cache left by the previous version.
steps: Restart the laptop to finish pending updates
Clear the application cache (the agent can do this with your approval)
Reinstall the application from the Company Portal if offered

solutions.title: Acme ERP web keeps returning to the sign-in page
solutions.problem: After I sign in to the ERP web portal the page reloads and asks me to sign in again, over and over.
solutions.symptoms: Sign-in loop; works in private window
solutions.root_cause: Stale session cookie for acme-demo.in.
steps: Try the application in a private browser window
Remove cookies for acme-demo.in from the browser
Make sure the browser uses your work profile
Close all browser windows and open the application again

solutions.title: Windows update fails repeatedly and the device turns non-compliant
solutions.problem: Windows update keeps failing every night with an install error and the Company Portal says my device is not compliant.
solutions.root_cause: Less than 20 GB free disk space and no restart for three weeks.
steps: Restart the laptop with Update and restart
Free at least 20 GB of disk space
Connect to the office network or VPN and check for updates
Use Check status in the Company Portal afterwards

solutions.title: Reporting a suspicious email that was not opened
solutions.problem: A message in my inbox wants me to confirm my mailbox through a link before it is closed. I have not opened the link.
solutions.root_cause: External phishing campaign.
steps: Do not click links or open attachments
Select the email and choose Report > Report phishing in Outlook
Delete the email after reporting it

solutions.title: Internal portal briefly returns 503 during a deployment
solutions.problem: The HR portal showed a 503 service unavailable page for a couple of minutes, now it loads again.
solutions.root_cause: Rolling deployment restarted application servers.
steps: Check https://status.acme-demo.in for maintenance
Reload the page after two minutes
Report it if more than one person is affected or it lasts longer than five minutes

solutions.title: Access denied to a team folder after moving teams
solutions.problem: After moving to the finance team I get you don't have permission to access this folder on the team share.
solutions.symptoms: Access denied on fs01 team folder
solutions.root_cause: Access group membership not yet requested from the data owner.
steps: Copy the full folder path
Request File share access in the Company Portal with the path
Sign out of Windows and back in after approval

solutions.title: Cannot connect to the ERP reporting replica from home
solutions.problem: SQL Server Management Studio cannot connect to the reporting database from home, it says a network-related or instance-specific error occurred.
solutions.root_cause: VPN not connected and short server name used.
steps: Connect GlobalProtect VPN first
Use erp-rpt.acme-demo.in,1433 as the server name
Use Windows authentication

solutions.title: Morning reports time out on the reporting database
solutions.problem: My sales report query times out early in the morning but runs fine in the afternoon.
solutions.root_cause: Report scheduled during the nightly data load.
steps: Run heavy reports after 04:00 IST
Add a date filter for the period you need
Select only the columns you need
